gherkinSteps: (structural/build-time behavior, not a runtime scenario)

requirements.feature: Vessel proxy: no TLS, no header forwarding (v1 scope limitation)
requirements.userStory: As implemented, `VesselProxyClient` forwards only method, path, and body to a resolved vessel target — plaintext only (no TLS support at all for the gateway's outbound or inbound side) and no request/response header forwarding in either direction (documented as deliberate v1 scope, not an oversight: correct header forwarding requires hop-by-hop stripping, `Host` rewriting, and avoiding double `Content-Length`, none of which is attempted).
requirements.statusDetail: Partial — explicitly out of scope for v1, documented in the class's own javadoc rather than a discovered gap
sourceLocations: `VesselProxyClient.java` (class javadoc, `proxy` method — only method/path/body set on the outbound request)
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `GatewayDispatcherTest#a_vessel_route_proxies_to_the_real_target_with_method_path_body_and_response_intact` confirms what *is* forwarded; no test exercises header forwarding since none exists
gherkinSteps: Given a vessel target that reads a custom request header
When a request carrying that header is proxied through the gateway
Then the header is not forwarded to the target (only method/path/body cross)
And the connection to the target is always plain HTTP, never HTTPS

requirements.feature: Fabric route "quiet success" ambiguity for a misrouted service name
requirements.userStory: As implemented, a `FabricRoute` naming an interface/method nothing currently exports is served as `200` with an empty body rather than a `404`/`502`, because `ModuleContext#invokeServiceByName`'s `Optional.empty()` return means either "no exporter known" or "found and returned void/null," and the dispatcher has no separate signal to distinguish the two.
requirements.statusDetail: Partial — documented, accepted limitation of routing purely by name with no separate existence check, not an oversight
sourceLocations: `GatewayDispatcher.java#dispatchFabric` (own javadoc explicitly documents this as a known v1 limitation)
gherkinSteps: Given a FabricRoute naming a service interface nothing currently exports
When a request is dispatched to that route
Then the response is 200 with an empty body (not an error)

requirements.feature: Deployment resource management (get/apply/delete)
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want to list, apply, and delete Deployment manifests from the command line, and see a deployment's status as readable columns rather than a raw JSON blob when I'm reading it as a table.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete. `get deployments` under the default table format flattens each deployment's nested `spec`/`instances`/quota/limit-range fields into derived columns (module coordinate, placed/desired replica count, a HEALTHY/UNPLACED(n)/QUOTA/LIMITRANGE rollup status) instead of a raw JSON-blob cell -- `-o json` is unaffected, still returning the full-fidelity raw shape for scripting. A manual user-perspective pass surfaced and fixed a real gap: the health column originally read only `quotaViolating`, so a deployment the API genuinely reported as `limitRangeViolating` still rendered `HEALTHY` here (the console's Deployments list had the identical blind spot, fixed alongside this one -- see GIMLE-604's own `limitRangeViolating`/`limitRangeViolationReason` status fields).
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `GimleCliTest.apply_then_get_deployments_round_trips`, `apply_then_delete_removes_the_deployment`, `apply_then_get_deployments_as_json_round_trips`, `apply_and_delete_deployment_produce_real_json_under_json_output_format`, `get_deployments_in_table_format_humanizes_spec_and_replicas_instead_of_raw_json`, `get_deployments_as_json_still_returns_the_raw_spec_shape`; `DeploymentsCommandTest.the_health_column_reports_limitrange_once_the_reconciler_flags_a_violation` (real cluster: pre-reconciler table output does not yet claim LIMITRANGE, a real `LimitRangeReconciler` tick then flips it on).
gherkinSteps: Given a control plane reachable at --server host:port, When I run "gimle apply -f orders-service.yaml" (kind:Deployment), Then /deployments/<name> is PUT; "gimle get deployments" lists it.

requirements.feature: Node inventory and cordon/uncordon
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want to list registered nodes and cordon a node before maintenance, and see each node's capacity as readable percentages/units rather than a raw JSON blob when I'm reading it as a table.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete (cordon/uncordon lacks dedicated test coverage). `get nodes` under the default table format flattens each node's nested `capabilities`/`capacity` fields into derived columns (comma-joined tiers, CPU/memory used-percent, human-readable byte/millicore totals, a HEALTHY/STALE/UNKNOWN heartbeat-freshness status) instead of a raw JSON-blob cell, matching the console's own humanization of the identical data -- `-o json` is unaffected, still returning the full-fidelity raw shape for scripting. Modified by the CLI parity work: `node cordon`/`uncordon`/`taint`/`untaint` no longer print a fixed human sentence regardless of -o, emitting a {result,kind,id[,tenantId]} JSON object under -o json; list/assignments rows were extracted into listRows()/assignmentRows() so `get --watch` can re-render them per tick.
gherkinSteps: Given node "node-a" registered, When "gimle cordon node-a", Then POST /nodes/node-a/cordon succeeds and prints "node/node-a cordoned".

requirements.feature: Instance lifecycle event timeline
requirements.userStory: As an operator debugging a misbehaving instance, I want to see its full lifecycle event history, and cap it to just the most recent entries when a crash loop would otherwise print hundreds of lines.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete, including `--tenant <id>` and `--limit N`. The store keys an instance's event timeline by the exact `(tenantId, deploymentName, instanceIndex)` triple, never a bare-name search across tenants (`StateStore.listInstanceEvents`), so a tenanted instance's timeline was previously unreachable from this command -- omitting `--tenant` always addressed the untenanted namespace, which for a real tenanted deployment is simply empty. `--tenant` is threaded through as `&tenant=<id>` on `GET /events`, the same `TenantQuery`/`CanICommand` convention every other by-name resource command already uses. `--limit N` still truncates the already-newest-first response client-side, since `GET /events` carries no server-side limit parameter of its own (unlike `GET /audit`).
sourceLocations: `gimle-cli/src/main/java/com/gimle/cli/GimleCli.java` (`events` dispatch passes flags through past the two positional args)
gherkinSteps: Given deployment "orders-service" index 0, When "gimle events orders-service 0", Then GET /events?deployment=orders-service&instance=0 results are printed.
Given an instance with more lifecycle events than --limit, When "gimle events orders-service 0 --limit 5", Then only the 5 most recent events print.

Given a tenanted instance's own lifecycle events; When "gimle events <name> <index> --tenant <id>"; Then that tenant's own timeline is printed, and neither the untenanted namespace nor a different tenant's timeline is ever returned in its place.

requirements.feature: Release rollback to a prior revision (`hilmir rollback`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator who shipped a bad revision, I want to re-apply a past revision's exact recorded state as a new revision.
gherkinSteps: Given release "orders" at rev 3, When "hilmir rollback --release orders" with no --to-revision, Then rev 2's snapshot re-applied as rev 4; explicit --to-revision reads that exact revision.

requirements.feature: Full release teardown (`hilmir undeploy`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator retiring a release, I want workloads deleted in reverse apply order, tenant deleted (unless --keep-tenants), and the ledger wiped.
gherkinSteps: Given release "orders" with workloads+tenant, When "hilmir undeploy --release orders", Then workloads deleted reverse-order, tenant deleted, ledger removed; --keep-tenants leaves the tenant.

requirements.feature: Release listing (`hilmir releases`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to see every release tracked in the ledger with its current revision and bundle version.
gherkinSteps: Given releases exist, When "hilmir releases", Then NAME/REVISION/BUNDLE_VERSION columns listed; empty ledger prints "No releases found.".

requirements.feature: Release status inspection (`hilmir release-status`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want a release's meta plus every resource's live control-plane status pulled in one command.
gherkinSteps: Given "hilmir release-status orders", Then bundleVersion/currentRevision/tenants plus each resource's live status printed; a fetch failure shows an "error" field rather than aborting.

requirements.feature: GitOps directory reconciliation (`hilmir sync`, incl. `--watch` and `--prune`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator running GitOps, I want a directory of bundles converged to the cluster in one command.
gherkinSteps: Given 3 bundle files (new, changed, unchanged), When "hilmir sync --dir ./bundles", Then new deployed, changed upgraded+pruned, unchanged reported "already-converged" with zero calls; "--prune" undeploys orphaned releases.

requirements.feature: `--watch` interval loop for sync
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want "hilmir sync --watch <seconds>" to keep re-running the reconcile pass on an interval.
requirements.statusDetail: Partial — deliberately untested, per its own documentation
requirements.testCoverageDetail: NONE (documented in class javadoc as deliberately untested convenience wrapper)
gherkinSteps: Given "hilmir sync --dir ./bundles --watch 30", Then the reconcile pass runs every 30s until interrupted.

requirements.feature: Bundle value templating and override precedence (`${values.*}` substitution)
requirements.userStory: As a bundle author, I want ${values.key} placeholders overridable by --values file then --set flags (Helm's precedence).
gherkinSteps: Given a bundle with values:{region:us-east}, When rendered with --set region=eu-west, Then eu-west wins; an unresolved reference fails with a named error, never a literal "${values.key}".

requirements.feature: Bundle manifest schema parsing and validation
requirements.userStory: As a bundle author, I want strict, allowlisted-field YAML parsing rejecting unknown keys and workload entries specifying neither/both of file/manifest.
gherkinSteps: Given an unrecognized top-level key, When parsed, Then GimleManifestException names it; a workload with both file and manifest is rejected as ambiguous.

requirements.feature: Workload readiness polling for `--wait`
requirements.userStory: As an operator applying a bundle with --wait, I want the CLI to block until each workload reaches a kind-appropriate ready state.
gherkinSteps: Given a Deployment applied with --wait, When instances haven't all reported ACTIVE, Then polls every 2s up to a 5-minute timeout.

requirements.feature: Doctor static deployability diagnostics (`hilmir doctor`)
requirements.userStory: As a developer preparing to deploy a jar, I want a static analysis pass catching deployability problems (packaging, manifest, tier 3, resources, probes, version drift, native code, System.exit, thread leaks, split packages, bundled logging bindings).
gherkinSteps: Given a jar declaring isolation.tier:TIER_3, When "hilmir doctor my-module.jar", Then TIER3_REQUESTED ERROR and exit 1; a launcher-archive jar under module intent is ERROR, under --vessel INFO.

requirements.feature: Doctor cluster-aware checks (`--server`, `--tenant`)
requirements.userStory: As a developer preparing a coordinate-only manifest, I want "doctor --server host:port" to confirm the coordinate exists in the registry and the target tenant exists.
gherkinSteps: Given a coordinate not present in the registry, When "hilmir doctor my-module.jar --server host:port", Then REGISTRY_COORDINATE_NOT_FOUND (ERROR); an unreachable registry gives REGISTRY_UNREACHABLE (WARNING) instead of a hard failure.

requirements.feature: Manifest scaffolding (`hilmir init`)
requirements.userStory: As a developer with a freshly built jar, I want "hilmir init" to generate a starter deployment.yaml (and gimle-module.yaml if module-shaped) with detected probe/hook classes.
gherkinSteps: Given a module-shaped jar with a detected LivenessProbe, When "hilmir init my-module.jar", Then both YAMLs written with the probe class filled confidently; existing deployment.yaml is never overwritten.

requirements.feature: Gateway extension enable (`hilmir enable gateway`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want a one-command way to push gimle-gateway's own jar to the registry and deploy/upgrade a synthesized bundle for it.
gherkinSteps: Given gimle-gateway not registered/deployed, When "hilmir enable gateway --server host:port", Then jar pushed and a synthesized bundle deployed fresh; identical-sha jar already registered skips the push; already-deployed at an older version upgrades instead.

requirements.feature: Gateway extension disable (`hilmir disable gateway`)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want a single command to undeploy the gimle-gateway release.
gherkinSteps: Given gateway currently enabled, When "hilmir disable gateway --server host:port", Then the release is fully undeployed; never-enabled reports a clear "nothing to disable" message.

requirements.feature: Bundled JRE resolution for platform-binary launches
requirements.userStory: As a deployer of a packaged distribution, I want processes launched via hilmir to use ${GIMLE_HOME}/jre/<component>/bin/java when runtime.useBundledJre is set.
gherkinSteps: Given runtime.useBundledJre:true and GIMLE_HOME set with jre/mimir/bin/java present, When planning a STORE process, Then that exact bundled java path is used; unset GIMLE_HOME fails clearly naming it.

requirements.feature: `java @argfile` command-line rewriting
requirements.userStory: As a launcher spawning a process with a long classpath, I want the command line rewritten to `java @argfile` form (JEP 293) to avoid OS command-line length limits.
gherkinSteps: Given a command with many arguments, When JavaArgFile.rewrite is called, Then each argument is individually quoted/escaped into an argfile, and the returned command is [javaExecutable, "@<argfile>"].

requirements.feature: Run ledger persistence for `up`/`down`/`status`/`upgrade-cluster`
requirements.userStory: As a durable record surviving across separate hilmir invocations, I need a corruption-tolerant JSON record of every spawned process's id/role/pid/command/log file/readiness address.
gherkinSteps: Given a set of RunRecords written via RunLedger.write, When read back, Then every field round-trips; a corrupt ledger file reports clearly rather than propagating a raw parse exception.

requirements.feature: TCP-connect readiness polling
requirements.userStory: As a launcher waiting on a just-spawned or remote prerequisite process, I want a uniform "successful TCP connect" readiness signal.
gherkinSteps: Given a port that never opens, When awaitPortOpen is called with a short timeout, Then times out with a clear message; an already-listening port returns immediately.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:agent` — spawn a real node agent (plus its worker command tail)
requirements.userStory: As a developer doing local-dev, I want a single goal that launches a real AgentMain with sensible dev defaults.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:agent" from gimle-agent, Then a real AgentMain process is spawned with the resolved runtime classpath, plus a worker command tail using gimle-worker's own independently-resolved classpath; run from another module, no-ops.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:bootstrap` — full local-dev cluster orchestration in one foreground command
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want one command bringing up store/muninn/andvari/fafnir/control-plane/agent+worker with a connection summary and clean Ctrl+C teardown.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:bootstrap" from the root project, Then processes spawn in dependency order, each awaited on its port; by default every gimle-examples module is deployed and awaited ACTIVE (best-effort); "-Dgimle.bootstrap.protocol=tls" runs PkiBootstrapMain first and wires mTLS.

requirements.feature: Process-launcher Maven goals for individual platform processes (`controlplane`/`store`/`fafnir`/`muninn`/`andvari`/`tls-init`)
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want one goal per platform process kind, each spawning a real subprocess with coordinated default ports/endpoints.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:store" from gimle-mimir, Then StoreMain spawned on raftPort 9080/clientPort 9091; "mvn gimle:controlplane" defaults --store-endpoints to 127.0.0.1:9091 and --fafnir-endpoint to 127.0.0.1:9092.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:deploy` — apply a deployment manifest via a real CLI subprocess
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want to apply a manifest to a running control plane as part of a Maven build/dev loop.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:deploy -Dgimle.deploy.file=deployment.yaml", Then a real GimleCli "apply -f <file> --server <server>" subprocess is spawned.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:doctor` — run hilmir doctor against the invoking project's own built jar
requirements.userStory: As a developer of any module, I want a goal running "hilmir doctor" against my own built jar without needing gimle-hilmir on my classpath.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `DoctorMojoTest` (4 tests, against the pure buildCommand seam)
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:doctor" bound to package phase, Then a real "doctor <jar>" subprocess runs with --vessel/--server/--tenant passed through only when set; a blank server is treated as unset.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:init` — scaffold manifests for the invoking project's own built jar
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a goal running "hilmir init" against my own built jar.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:init", Then a real "init <jar> [--out-dir <dir>]" subprocess is spawned; blank outDir treated as unset.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:publish` — push a built module jar to the artifact registry
requirements.userStory: As a module developer, I want a goal that pushes my just-built jar to Andvari via a real CLI subprocess.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:publish", Then a real "artifact push <file> --server <server>" subprocess is spawned using gimle-cli's independently resolved classpath.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:docs` — full documentation site build pipeline
requirements.userStory: As a maintainer, I want one command running javadoc:aggregate, copying it into the docs site's static assets, and building the Docusaurus site via Bun.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:docs" from the root project, Then javadoc:aggregate runs, output copied to gimle-docs/static/javadoc, then "bun install"/"bun run build"; missing aggregated output logs a warning without failing.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:flaky-tests` — run known-flaky-tagged tests in isolated standalone reactors
requirements.userStory: As a maintainer, I want each module's @Tag("flaky") tests run as their own genuinely separate child mvn process, removing cross-module Surefire-JVM contention.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:flaky-tests" (default modules=gimle-mimir, repeat=1), Then a standalone "mvn -pl gimle-mimir test -Dgroups=flaky ..." child runs; -Dgimle.flakyTests.repeat=0 fails immediately before spawning anything.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:saga` — ensure a Saga test-report server is running
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a goal reusing an already-healthy Saga server or spawning a fresh detached one.
gherkinSteps: Given no Saga server listening on 9096, When "mvn gimle:saga", Then a real SagaMain process is spawned detached, pid recorded, health-polled until ready or a 30s timeout; a healthy server is reused.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:verify` — full build run under Saga tracking
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a goal ensuring Saga is up, minting a run id, spawning the actual build as a separate child, and importing surefire reports at the end.
gherkinSteps: Given "mvn gimle:verify -Dgimle.saga.mavenArgs='clean verify -Psmoke'", Then a run id like "2026-08-17T10-00-00_abc1234" is minted, the child mvn command spawned/streamed, surefire reports swept and imported, run-finished posted; a non-zero child exit fails this build too, only after import.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:saga-import` — standalone sweep-and-import of existing surefire reports
requirements.userStory: As a developer who already ran a plain "mvn verify", I want to import its surefire results into an already-running Saga server after the fact.
gherkinSteps: Given a running Saga server and existing target/surefire-reports/*.xml files, When "mvn gimle:saga-import", Then every discovered report is imported under a freshly-minted or explicit --runId; no reachable server fails immediately.

requirements.feature: `mvn gimle:saga-stop` — best-effort local Saga server shutdown
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a goal that asks the Saga server to shut down gracefully, falling back to signalling its recorded pid.
gherkinSteps: Given a running Saga server, When "mvn gimle:saga-stop", Then POST /api/shutdown called and pidfile deleted; neither present reports "nothing to stop" without failing.

requirements.feature: Internal — Aether-based cross-module runtime classpath resolution
requirements.userStory: As a goal that spawns a different reactor module's process, I need to resolve that module's full runtime classpath against its already-installed jar via Maven's dependency resolver, independent of reactor build order.
gherkinSteps: Given GimleProcesses.resolveRuntimeClasspath("gimle-worker", version, ...), Then resolves the artifact and its runtime dependencies via Aether; a never-installed artifact throws a clear MojoExecutionException suggesting "mvn install" first.

requirements.feature: Internal — host-matching java/mvn executable resolution and subprocess supervision
requirements.userStory: As every process-spawning goal, I need to resolve the exact java/mvn launcher the current build is running under, and shared spawn/wait/shutdown-hook helpers.
gherkinSteps: Given GimleProcesses.javaExecutable(), Then returns the real java binary this Maven process runs under; mavenLauncherUnder(mavenHome) resolves bin/mvn or empty.

requirements.feature: Internal — git commit/branch capture for run identification
requirements.userStory: As gimle:verify/gimle:saga-import, I need the working tree's current short commit sha and branch, degrading gracefully with no git.
gherkinSteps: Given a real git repo, When GitInfo.capture(root) is called, Then real short sha/branch returned; no .git or 10s timeout returns both empty rather than throwing.

requirements.feature: Internal — surefire report discovery and totals aggregation, including flaky-testcase counting
requirements.userStory: As every Saga goal, I need to recursively discover surefire XML reports, parse both testsuite shapes, sum totals, and count flaky testcases once per testcase.
gherkinSteps: Given a mix of testsuite-rooted and testsuites-wrapped XML files, When SurefireReports.totals is called, Then counts summed correctly; a testcase with a flakyFailure element counts once regardless of rerun attempts; unparseable files are warned about and skipped.

requirements.feature: Operator session login / logout
requirements.userStory: As a cluster operator, I want to sign in with a username/password, so that only authorized people can operate the cluster through the console.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete (plaintext mode reports a synthetic anonymous principal instead of forcing login — deliberate)
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `src/stores/useAuthStore.test.ts` — "a successful login sets status authenticated and clears any previous error", "login failure surfaces a generic error and leaves status unauthenticated"
gherkinSteps: Given I am unauthenticated, When I submit valid credentials on `/login`, Then I am redirected to the Overview screen and my principal is stored; Given invalid credentials, Then an "invalid username or password" error is shown.

requirements.feature: Session bootstrap & 401 handling
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want the console to detect an existing/expired session automatically.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `useAuthStore.test.ts` — "init() only calls session() once even if invoked twice", "handleUnauthorized clears principal and sets status unauthenticated"
gherkinSteps: Given a valid session cookie exists, When the app loads, Then `/auth/session` resolves my principal without a login prompt; Given any API call returns 401, Then the store clears my principal and redirects to `/login`.

requirements.feature: Cluster Overview dashboard
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want an at-a-glance summary of nodes, deployments, tenants, and health.
gherkinSteps: Given the console loads `/`, When overview data is fetched, Then node/deployment/tenant totals and staleness indicators render as metric tiles.

requirements.feature: Tactical HUD / Signal display-mode toggle
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to switch between a dense "HUD" layout and a simplified "signal" layout.
gherkinSteps: Given I toggle display mode, When I select "signal", Then `OverviewSignal` renders instead of the default HUD layout, persisting via localStorage.

requirements.feature: Deployments list/create/detail/delete
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to list, create, inspect, and delete module deployments.
gherkinSteps: Given I fill the "New deployment" form, When I submit, Then a new deployment is created and I'm navigated to its detail page; Given ACTIVE, When I delete and confirm, Then it is removed.

requirements.feature: Jobs (run-to-completion workload) list
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view run-to-completion Jobs and their phase/attempt state.
gherkinSteps: Given Jobs exist, When I open `/jobs`, Then each job's phase is listed; no "create" form (job manifests applied via CLI).

requirements.feature: CronJobs list/detail
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view scheduled CronJobs.
gherkinSteps: Given CronJobs exist, When I open `/cronjobs`, Then each entry's schedule/concurrency policy is listed with a link to run history.

requirements.feature: DaemonSets list/detail
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view node-scoped DaemonSet workloads.
gherkinSteps: Given a DaemonSet is deployed, When I open `/daemonsets`, Then per-node placement status is shown.

requirements.feature: StatefulSets list/detail
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view stable-identity StatefulSet workloads.
gherkinSteps: Given a StatefulSet is deployed, When I open `/statefulsets`, Then each ordinal replica's identity/lifecycle is shown.

requirements.feature: Instances table with filtering (global + node/tenant-scoped)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view every running module instance with filters by lifecycle state/node/tenant.
gherkinSteps: Given I navigate from a node's detail page, When instances loads, Then it's pre-filtered to that node's instances; navigating directly resets any leftover filter.

requirements.feature: Nodes list/detail with capacity bars and staleness
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to see every node's heartbeat freshness and CPU/memory capacity usage.
gherkinSteps: Given a node's last heartbeat exceeds the staleness threshold, When I view `/nodes`, Then that node is visually flagged stale.

requirements.feature: Tenants list/detail with quota management and delete
requirements.userStory: As a platform admin, I want to create/inspect/delete tenants and view their resource quotas.
gherkinSteps: Given a tenant with active deployments, When I attempt to delete it, Then a confirmation dialog is shown before the delete request fires.

requirements.feature: Topology placement map
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want a visual map of deployment replicas placed across nodes, grouped by tenant or node.
gherkinSteps: Given a deployment has fewer placed instances than its replica count, When I view `/topology`, Then hollow squares show unplaced slots, tagged "warn"/"bad".

requirements.feature: Cluster metrics charts (lifecycle mix, capacity, quota pressure)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want charted views of lifecycle-state mix, placement coverage, node capacity balance, tenant quota pressure.
gherkinSteps: Given cluster/tenant data are loaded, When I open `/metrics`, Then pie/scatter charts render via recharts.

requirements.feature: Per-process metrics history (Muninn-backed)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to pick a process and see its metrics history over time.
gherkinSteps: Given I pick a process target via `ProcessPicker`, When metrics history loads, Then `GET /metrics-history/*` results render as a time-series panel.

requirements.feature: Trace span history viewer
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want a sortable table of trace spans per process.
gherkinSteps: Given traces exist, When I open `/traces` and sort by status, Then rows re-order; ERROR-status spans are visually distinguished.

requirements.feature: Log explorer with live tailing
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view and live-tail logs for an instance, node, or the control plane.
gherkinSteps: Given I open `/logs` with no query params, Then it falls back to the control-plane PLATFORM target instead of crashing; Given I click "follow", Then new lines are polled via `since=` cursor and appended live.

requirements.feature: Crash-dump (hs_err) listing on Logs screen
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to see JVM crash-dump files for a crashed instance directly in the Logs screen.
gherkinSteps: Given an instance crashed and left an hs_err file, When I view its logs, Then the crash dump is listed.

requirements.feature: Config entries management (per-tenant)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to view, add, reveal, and remove per-tenant config entries.
gherkinSteps: Given an encrypted config entry, When I click "reveal", Then its decrypted value is fetched on demand; "hide" clears it from view without re-fetching.

requirements.feature: Secrets management (Fafnir-backed, versioned)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to browse, reveal, version, write, soft-delete, and hard-destroy per-tenant secrets.
gherkinSteps: Given a secret has multiple versions, When I request an older version, Then that specific version's value is fetched via `?version=N`; destroy=true removes the entry entirely.

requirements.feature: Module artifact registry browser (Andvari-backed)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to browse module jars pushed to Andvari and delete versions.
gherkinSteps: Given an artifact module is selected, When I request its versions, Then only that module's versions load on demand.

requirements.feature: RBAC access control (roles, role bindings, accounts)
requirements.userStory: As a platform admin, I want to create/edit/delete roles, bind roles to subjects, and manage operator accounts.
requirements.statusDetail: Modified by the console parity work: the Roles editor's permission picker is no longer driven by a hand-maintained TypeScript copy of ResourceKind/Verb that had drifted from the server's own enums -- it fetches the live vocabulary from GET /authz/vocabulary.
gherkinSteps: Given I edit a role's permissions, When I add a permission row and save, Then `PUT /roles/{name}` sends the updated permission list.

requirements.feature: Audit trail viewer with filtering
requirements.userStory: As an operator/auditor, I want a filterable log of principal, resource, tenant, and allow/deny decisions.
requirements.statusDetail: Modified by the console parity work: the Audit screen's `since` filter now sends epoch millis, the format ApiServer actually parses (it previously sent an ISO-8601 string, which the server rejected, so the filter never worked), and the viewer consumes the paged cursor response.
gherkinSteps: Given I set a date-range/verb filter, When search runs, Then results sort newest-first regardless of response order.

requirements.feature: Control-plane status panel
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want a quick status view of scheduler/quota-enforcer running state.
requirements.statusDetail: Partial (static status display, hardcoded "running" badges, not wired to a live per-subsystem health API)
gherkinSteps: Given the control plane is running, When I open `/controlplane`, Then scheduler/quota-enforcer badges show "running".

requirements.feature: Theme toggle (light/dark)
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want to switch between light and dark themes.
gherkinSteps: Given I click the theme toggle, When dark mode is selected, Then the preference persists across reloads.

requirements.feature: Playwright end-to-end smoke suite against a real cluster
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want an automated browser test proving the console reflects real deployed-module state.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `e2e/greeter-smoke.spec.ts` (opt-in, `bun run test:e2e`, excluded from default Vitest run)
gherkinSteps: Given a real control plane with greeter-provider/consumer deployed, When the Playwright suite runs, Then Deployments/Logs screens reflect genuine real state.

requirements.feature: Vault operator login/logout (session-cookie auth)
requirements.userStory: As a vault operator, I want to sign in to the Fafnir console with credentials.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete (deliberate auth, mirroring gimle-console — unlike gimle-saga-console)
gherkinSteps: Given plaintext mode with no bootstrap account, When session endpoint loads, Then a synthetic anonymous principal is returned; TLS mode with valid credentials sets a `gimle_fafnir_session`-style cookie.

requirements.feature: Vault status overview (uptime, active key, transport mode, tenants)
requirements.userStory: As a vault operator, I want a live overview of Fafnir's uptime, active key id, transport mode, and known tenants.
gherkinSteps: Given the vault is running, When I open the overview route, Then uptime is formatted `Xd Yh Zm`, active key id and tenant count shown from `GET /status`.

requirements.feature: Secrets browsing/reveal/version/write/destroy (vault-native UI)
requirements.userStory: As a vault operator, I want to browse secrets, reveal values, view version history, write new versions, and soft-/hard-delete a key.
gherkinSteps: Given a secret has 3 versions, When I view its history, Then all versions are listed with the latest flagged; "destroy" permanently removes it.

requirements.feature: Tenant filter via URL search param
requirements.userStory: As a vault operator, I want to deep-link to a specific tenant's secrets via a query parameter.
gherkinSteps: Given a URL of `/secrets?tenant=acme`, When the route loads, Then the list is pre-filtered to tenant `acme`.

requirements.feature: Key rotation trigger
requirements.userStory: As a vault operator, I want to rotate the vault's active encryption key from the UI.
gherkinSteps: Given I trigger rotation, When complete, Then the new active key id is returned and reflected in the status panel.

requirements.feature: Fafnir console error banner / global error capture
requirements.userStory: As a vault operator, I want API errors surfaced clearly in-page.
gherkinSteps: Given an API call fails, When the error propagates to the store, Then `ErrorBanner` renders the message.

requirements.feature: Andvari operator login/logout (session-cookie auth)
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want to sign in to the Andvari console.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `src/repositories/__tests__/repositories.test.ts` — "returns an anonymous principal by default", "rejects empty credentials"
gherkinSteps: Given plaintext mode with no account seeded, When session endpoint loads, Then an anonymous principal is returned rather than 401.

requirements.feature: Registry status overview (uptime, transport, recent pushes)
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want to see uptime, transport mode, and recent artifact pushes.
gherkinSteps: Given artifacts have been pushed recently, When I open the overview route, Then `selectRecentPushes` surfaces the most recent pushes.

requirements.feature: Artifact catalog browsing & search
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want to browse and search the module-jar catalog by module id.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `repositories.test.ts` — "returns a sorted catalog of module ids"
gherkinSteps: Given the catalog is loaded, When I type into the search box, Then the list filters client-side by substring match.

requirements.feature: Artifact version detail (download, checksum display, delete)
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want to see every stored version of a module and download or delete a version.
gherkinSteps: Given a module has multiple versions, When I select it, Then its versions load on demand; deleting a version calls `DELETE /artifacts/{moduleId}/{version}`.

requirements.feature: Client-side SHA-256 checksum verification on download
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want a downloaded artifact's bytes verified against the registry-reported SHA-256 in the browser.
gherkinSteps: Given downloaded jar bytes, When `verifySha256` compares them against the `X-Gimle-Artifact-Sha256` header, Then a mismatch is flagged.

requirements.feature: Push artifact dialog (drag-and-drop upload)
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want to push a new module jar with module id/version.
gherkinSteps: Given I push an existing module@version unmodified, When upload completes, Then it's treated as an idempotent no-op; a differing re-push surfaces a 409 conflict.

requirements.feature: Maven-2 repository interop view

gherkinSteps: Given the console is served at a known origin, When I open `/repository`, Then the repository base URL and a copyable Maven config snippet render.

requirements.feature: Andvari copy-to-clipboard utility
requirements.userStory: As a registry operator, I want a one-click copy button for URLs/snippets/coordinates.
gherkinSteps: Given I click the copy button next to the repository URL, When the click completes, Then the value is written to the clipboard.

requirements.feature: Runs list (no authentication)
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want to see every Gimlé test run newest-first with status, totals, flake counts, and duration.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete (deliberately no authentication — local development tool, loopback-bound by default)
gherkinSteps: Given runs exist, When I open `/`, Then rows are searchable by runId/branch/gitSha/command via client-side filtering.

requirements.feature: Live run detail with streaming test feed
requirements.userStory: As a developer watching a build run, I want a live-updating feed of test results for one run.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `src/repositories/http/runs.test.ts` — "followRunEvents streams new finished-test events and skips the already-known count"
gherkinSteps: Given a run is LIVE, When I open its detail page, Then new finished-test events are streamed in via NDJSON polling, ending once terminal.

requirements.feature: Run attachments: Gherkin scenario tree, Chaos ledger, Surtr phase table
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want to see attached Gherkin/chaos-soak/Surtr output embedded in a run's detail page.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `src/repositories/http/mapping.test.ts` — "groups attachment events by kind and skips unparseable or unrecognized payloads", "accepts a payload shipped as an array of the shape"
gherkinSteps: Given a run's events include attachment payloads, When I switch tabs, Then each tab renders its own structured view.

requirements.feature: Test detail / per-test history
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want to see one test's outcome history, duration trend, and failure signatures across recent runs.
gherkinSteps: Given a test has run across several builds, When I open its detail page, Then an outcome strip renders each run's result chronologically.

requirements.feature: Compare two runs (diff view)
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want to diff two runs to see newly failing/passing/flaky tests and duration regressions over 25%.
gherkinSteps: Given a base/head run selection, When compare loads, Then newly-failing/passing/recovered and >25%-slower tests are each listed.

requirements.feature: Gjallarhorn flake scoreboard
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a ranked scoreboard of flaky tests with quarantine status and a flake budget.
gherkinSteps: Given a 30-day window, When the scoreboard loads, Then entries rank by score descending, quarantined tests are marked, and budget is computed without dividing by zero.

requirements.feature: Saga console theming (no auth surface)
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want the Saga console to load directly without a login screen.
requirements.statusDetail: Complete (deliberately no auth — local dev tool)
gherkinSteps: Given the console is served, When I navigate to any route, Then no authentication check or redirect occurs.

requirements.feature: NDJSON event ingest API
requirements.userStory: As a test infrastructure integrator, I want to POST batches of NDJSON SagaEvent lines to `/api/ingest`.
gherkinSteps: Given a batch with a malformed event on line 3, When I POST it, Then rejected with 400 naming the line number, none persisted.

requirements.feature: Idempotent per-run ingest / re-ingest replacement
requirements.userStory: As a test infrastructure integrator, I want a re-shipped whole run to replace the prior copy rather than duplicate it.
gherkinSteps: Given a run already ingested with ledger observations, When re-ingested from scratch, Then its old directory/ledger lines are deleted first and replaced.

requirements.feature: Crash-safe append (torn-tail recovery)
requirements.userStory: As an operator of the Saga process, I want a crash mid-append to never corrupt the events file.
gherkinSteps: Given the last line has no trailing newline (torn write), When a new append occurs, Then the fragment is truncated first.

requirements.feature: Surefire/Failsafe XML import
requirements.userStory: As a test infrastructure integrator, I want to import existing Surefire/Failsafe XML reports into Saga.
gherkinSteps: Given a report with a `flakyFailure` element, When imported, Then translated into a failed attempt followed by a passing one; unparseable XML rejected with 400.

requirements.feature: Fold-import safety net for a live run's gap
requirements.userStory: As a test infrastructure integrator, I want to fold an XML import into an already-live-streamed run rather than overwrite it.
gherkinSteps: Given a run has live-streamed events for some tests, When I import an XML report for the same runId, Then only test IDs with no `TestFinished` yet are appended, framing never duplicated.

requirements.feature: Run listing, detail, and cursor-paginated event reads
requirements.userStory: As a console client, I want to list runs, fetch one run's meta, and read its event log from a cursor.
gherkinSteps: Given a run's meta.json is missing or stale, When requested, Then reconstructed on the fly by replaying events.ndjson.

requirements.feature: Live NDJSON tail (`follow=true`) of a run's event stream
requirements.userStory: As a console client, I want a chunked HTTP stream that tails a run's events as they arrive.
gherkinSteps: Given a run is LIVE, When I request `/api/runs/{id}/events?follow=true`, Then new lines stream as appended; the stream closes only after the run reaches terminal AND every line has been delivered.

requirements.feature: Abandoned-run detection on restart
requirements.userStory: As an operator, I want any run still marked LIVE at server startup automatically marked ABANDONED.
gherkinSteps: Given a run was LIVE when Saga last shut down, When the server restarts, Then that run's status is rewritten to ABANDONED before any read can observe it.

requirements.feature: Flake ledger derivation (fail-then-pass rule) and rebuild
requirements.userStory: As a test infrastructure integrator, I want Saga to automatically derive flake observations whenever a run finishes, and rebuild the whole ledger from scratch.
gherkinSteps: Given a test fails attempt 1 and passes attempt 2 in the same run, When the run finishes, Then exactly one flake observation is recorded.

requirements.feature: Flaky scoreboard with time-window ranking
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a `GET /api/flaky?window=N` endpoint ranking tests by flake score within a time window.
gherkinSteps: Given observations both inside/outside a 30-day window, When I query the scoreboard, Then only in-window observations count.

requirements.feature: Test-tag index and quarantine status
requirements.userStory: As a developer, I want a test's most recently observed JUnit tags tracked as a current-state index.
gherkinSteps: Given a test was last observed tagged `flaky`, When I query quarantine status, Then it reports true even if an earlier run tagged it differently.

requirements.feature: Per-test history endpoint
requirements.userStory: As a console client, I want `GET /api/tests/{testId}/history` for the Test Detail screen.
gherkinSteps: Given a test ran in 3 runs with a flaky pass in one, When I request its history, Then each entry reports the final attempt's outcome/duration and flaky flag.

requirements.feature: Path traversal protection on run IDs
requirements.userStory: As an operator of the Saga process, I want run IDs used as directory names strictly allow-listed.
gherkinSteps: Given a run ID containing `../` or path separators, When validated, Then rejected with 400.

requirements.feature: Bundled console static serving
requirements.userStory: As a developer running Saga locally, I want the bundled gimle-saga-console SPA served automatically at `/console`.
gherkinSteps: Given the console jar is bundled, When SagaMain starts, Then `/console` serves the SPA; absent, `/console` is disabled with a log line.

requirements.feature: Poll-until-condition primitive (`Await`)
requirements.userStory: As a test author writing real-cluster tests, I want a spin-poll-until-true helper instead of a fixed sleep.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: NONE directly (used pervasively across gimle-mimir/gimle-fabric/gimle-worker/gimle-controlplane test sources)
gherkinSteps: Given a boolean condition and a timeout, When the condition becomes true before the deadline, Then `Await.until` returns immediately; When the deadline passes first, Then it throws naming the condition.

requirements.feature: Kernel-assigned loopback port leasing (`PortLease`)
requirements.userStory: As a real-cluster test fixture, I want to reserve a whole port budget up front via bound loopback sockets.
gherkinSteps: Given a requested port count, When `PortLease.reserve(n)` is called, Then n distinct kernel-assigned loopback ports are bound and held; `release(port)` closes the socket and hands the port number to the process.

requirements.feature: Heimdall event-driven cluster condition harness
requirements.userStory: As a cluster-validation test author, I want to await conditions over real cluster state driven by events rather than polling loops in my own test code.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: NONE at unit level (exercised by every gimle-holmgang scenario); `ClusterViewTest` covers view-parsing
gherkinSteps: Given control-plane replica base URLs and supervised processes, When a registered view/log/probe condition's predicate becomes true, Then the corresponding HeimdallCondition future completes; a supervised process dying fails every pending condition immediately.

requirements.feature: Replica-scoped condition observation
requirements.userStory: As a multi-replica-cluster test author, I want to scope a condition to one specific control-plane replica's own observed view.
gherkinSteps: Given `cluster.when(1)`, When a ClusterView satisfying the predicate is fetched from replica 1, Then the condition completes; views from other replicas are ignored.

requirements.feature: Deployment/node/log condition builders
requirements.userStory: As a scenario author, I want typed, fluent condition builders for common deployment/node/log assertions.
gherkinSteps: Given a deployment name, When `.isActive()`/`.hasActiveReplicas(n)`/`.allOnVersion(v,n)`/`.hasFailedInstance()`/`.isAbsent()`/`.reportsQuotaViolation()` is awaited, Then it resolves once the corresponding condition holds.

requirements.feature: Time-windowed negative invariants (`Invariant`/`InvariantGuard`)
requirements.userStory: As a scenario author asserting a negative property, I want to hold an invariant over a fixed window and fail with a forensic report the moment it breaks.
gherkinSteps: Given an Invariant and a Duration window, When `holdFor(invariant, window)` runs, Then every observed view is checked; the call throws with a forensic report the instant one violates it.

requirements.feature: Forensic failure reporting
requirements.userStory: As a developer debugging a failed real-cluster test, I want every condition timeout/failure to carry a rendered snapshot of cluster state.
gherkinSteps: Given a condition times out or a process dies, When the failure is raised, Then the error message includes the last ClusterView, process liveness, recent harness events, and recent platform events.

requirements.feature: `hello-module` — minimal inert deployable fixture
requirements.userStory: As a platform developer doing manual QA, I want a trivial, deliberately inert real module artifact with distinct request/limit resource values.
gherkinSteps: Given the hello-module jar and its deployment.yaml, When deployed with 1 replica, Then it reaches ACTIVE with no health probes or lifecycle hooks resolved (none declared).

requirements.feature: `greeter-provider` — real fabric service export with lifecycle hooks and health probes
requirements.userStory: As a platform developer proving the fabric works end to end, I want a real Tier 2 module that registers a Greeter service on onStart, reports readiness once registered, and reads a tenant secret/config value.
gherkinSteps: Given greeter-provider deployed with a tenant, When the instance starts, Then it registers Greeter on the fabric, ReadinessProbe reports ready only after registration, and logs the tenant's secret value fetched via ctx.config(...).

requirements.feature: `greeter-consumer` — real cross-worker fabric call with MDC-tagged background caller
requirements.userStory: As a platform developer proving cross-worker service invocation, I want a module that repeatedly looks up and calls Greeter on a background virtual thread, re-resolving on every call.
gherkinSteps: Given greeter-consumer deployed alongside greeter-provider, When the consumer's background loop runs, Then every 5s it looks up Greeter, calls greet("Gimlé"), and logs the reply with its own instance's MDC tags applied.

requirements.feature: `greeter-load-generator` — HTTP bridge for external load tools driving real fabric traffic
requirements.userStory: As a load-testing harness (Gatling), I want an HTTP endpoint inside a real hosted module that performs a synchronous fabric lookup+call per request.
gherkinSteps: Given greeter-load-generator deployed with load.port via tenant config, When an HTTP GET hits /call, Then it performs a real lookupService(Greeter.class)+greet("Gatling") call and reflects 200/502/503 based on outcome.

requirements.feature: Real multi-process cluster fixture (store/control-plane/agent/Fafnir/Muninn)
requirements.userStory: As a smoke-test author, I want a shared fixture that spawns a genuine multi-node Raft store cluster, multiple control-plane replicas, one node agent, multiple Fafnir replicas, and a Muninn replica as real OS subprocesses.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: Base fixture for every `*IT` in this module (24 concrete IT classes)
gherkinSteps: Given `GreeterSmokeClusterSupport.startCluster()`, When the fixture boots, Then 3 store nodes, 2 control-plane replicas, 1 agent, 2 Fafnir replicas, and 1 Muninn are all live real processes torn down in reverse dependency order.

requirements.feature: On-the-fly compiled module variants via `TestModuleBuilder`
requirements.userStory: As a smoke-test author needing a faulty/slow/leaky/version-bumped module without modifying the real committed example, I want purpose-built module variants compiled at test run time.
sourceLocations: `GreeterSmokeClusterSupport.java` (buildGreeterProviderVariant, buildProviderV2Jar, buildFaultyProviderJar, buildAlwaysBrokenProviderJar, buildAlwaysUnhealthyProviderJar, buildLeakyProviderJar, buildInertTier1ModuleJar, buildQuickSucceedingJobModuleJar, buildStatefulModuleJar, buildSlowProviderJar)
requirements.testCoverageDetail: Used by ClassloaderLeakIT, RedeployStabilityIT, SelfHealingIT, ServiceFabricIT, Tier1DensityIT, JobLifecycleIT, StatefulSetPersistenceIT, AutoscaleIT, RollingUpdateIT, SurgePromotionIT
gherkinSteps: Given a variant spec, When `buildFaultyProviderJar()` is called, Then a real compiled jar with that behavior is produced and deployable through the real HTTP API.

requirements.feature: Base cluster topology deploy across store cluster and multiple CP replicas
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want deployments to reach ACTIVE consistently regardless of which control-plane replica served the submission or is being observed.
gherkinSteps: Given a real cluster, When greeter-provider and greeter-consumer are deployed, Then both reach ACTIVE (observed via a different replica than submission), the consumer's fabric call appears in its own log, and the provider's log shows its secret round-tripped through Fafnir.

requirements.feature: Raft store resilience (member loss, leader failover, live membership change)
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want the state store to tolerate losing a member (including the leader) mid-workload with zero acknowledged-write loss, and support adding/removing members live.
gherkinSteps: Given a real 3-store cluster with concurrent writes in flight, When a store node (or the leader) is killed, Then the cluster keeps accepting writes and no acknowledged write is lost.

requirements.feature: Tiered self-healing (worker respawn, liveness-exhaustion escalation to FAILED)
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a killed worker JVM automatically respawned and its instance returned to ACTIVE, and a module that never passes liveness to escalate to FAILED once its restart budget exhausts.
gherkinSteps: Given an ACTIVE instance, When its worker JVM is force-killed, Then the agent respawns a new worker and the deployment returns to ACTIVE; a never-recovering module escalates to FAILED after budget exhaustion.

requirements.feature: Classloader leak detection wired into a real worker
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a module that leaks its own classloader on redeploy to be detected and reported by the worker's real LeakTracker.
sourceLocations: `ClassloaderLeakIT.java` (also fixed a real gap: WorkerMain previously never wired LeakTracker into the real ModuleController)
gherkinSteps: Given a module leaving a background platform thread running past onStop, When redeployed to a new version, Then a ModuleLeakDetected event is logged to worker-platform.log.

requirements.feature: Repeated redeploy stability without false-positive leaks
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a well-behaved module to survive several real redeploy cycles on a shared worker without ever reporting a false-positive leak.
gherkinSteps: Given a well-behaved module on a shared Tier 1 worker, When redeployed several times in a row, Then LeakTracker never reports a leak for any cycle.

requirements.feature: Tier 1 worker density packing and its cap
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator relying on Tier 1 density, I want several distinct Tier 1 modules to genuinely share one worker JVM up to MAX_TIER1_DENSITY.
gherkinSteps: Given up to MAX_TIER1_DENSITY distinct Tier 1 modules deployed, When each deploys, Then all pack onto one real worker process; one more distinct module gets a fresh worker.

requirements.feature: Node cordoning blocks new placement without evicting running instances
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator performing maintenance, I want a cordoned node to accept no new placements while never evicting what's already running there.
gherkinSteps: Given a cordoned single-node cluster, When a new deployment is submitted, Then it stays unplaced, while an already-running instance keeps serving.

requirements.feature: DaemonSet per-node fan-out and dead-node assignment cleanup
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator running cluster-wide agents, I want a DaemonSet to place one instance on every eligible node and have a dead node's assignment cleaned up.
gherkinSteps: Given a DaemonSet deployed across 2 real agent nodes, When both are up, Then one instance per node; When one node's agent is hard-killed, Then that node's assignment is cleaned up.

requirements.feature: Job and CronJob real-cluster lifecycle
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a Job to run its JobHooks#run on a real worker JVM and reach SUCCEEDED, and a CronJob trigger to generate a real Job that succeeds.
gherkinSteps: Given a Job-kind module returning SUCCEEDED, When deployed, Then it reaches JobPhase.SUCCEEDED; a triggered CronJob generates a Job that likewise succeeds.

requirements.feature: StatefulSet sticky placement and volume persistence across worker restart
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator running stateful workloads, I want a StatefulSet instance's persistent volume and node placement to survive a worker crash-and-respawn.
gherkinSteps: Given a StatefulSet instance that wrote a marker file, When its worker is killed and respawned, Then the instance lands on the same node and sees the marker file already present.

requirements.feature: Rolling update preserves serving capacity and reaches new version
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator rolling out a new module version, I want a surge-budgeted rollout to never drop below the guaranteed replica floor and every instance to end on the new version.
gherkinSteps: Given a 2-replica deployment with maxUnavailable=1/maxSurge=1, When rolled to v1.1.0, Then at least 1 instance stays ACTIVE throughout and all 2 end on v1.1.0.

requirements.feature: Surge worker promotion carries out via in-place retarget, not respawn
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator relying on surge rollouts, I want a promoted surge worker to keep its exact OS process while the vacated index gets a genuinely new process.
gherkinSteps: Given a 2-replica rollout with maxUnavailable=1/maxSurge=1, When the surge worker is promoted, Then its OS PID is unchanged, while the other (restarted) instance's PID changes.

requirements.feature: Autoscaling under real request-rate, error-rate, queue-depth, and weighted-blended load
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want deployments to scale up in response to real worker-reported request rate, error rate, or queue depth signals.
gherkinSteps: Given an autoscale policy targeting a signal, When real Gatling-generated load pushes it past target, Then the deployment scales toward maxReplicas.

requirements.feature: Multi-tenant quota enforcement (flag-not-evict, and admission rejection)
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a retroactively-lowered quota to flag a violating deployment without eviction, and a new deployment exceeding quota rejected at admission.
gherkinSteps: Given a tenant already running at quota, When quota is lowered, Then the deployment is flagged but keeps running; a new submission exceeding quota is rejected with 409.

requirements.feature: Circuit breaker excludes a consistently-failing replica
requirements.userStory: As a service fabric consumer, I want repeated real failures from one endpoint to open its circuit breaker and exclude it.
gherkinSteps: Given a genuinely broken provider replica hanging past the client timeout, When enough consecutive calls fail via real timeout, Then FabricServiceRegistry's breaker opens and excludes that replica.

requirements.feature: Gossip/SWIM failure detection across real separate agent processes
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a hard-killed member to converge to "dead" on every surviving agent's own gossip view.
gherkinSteps: Given real agent processes joined via gossip, When one is hard-killed, Then every surviving agent's SWIM state eventually marks it dead.

requirements.feature: Observability data survives agent death (Muninn fallback) and control-plane metrics round-trip
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a deployed instance's log to remain readable via Muninn after its agent dies, and control-plane metrics to round-trip through Muninn.
gherkinSteps: Given a deployed instance logging normally, When its agent dies, Then its log is still readable via the /logs/* Muninn fallback.

requirements.feature: Worker-tier metrics/trace relay to Muninn via the agent
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a module's own request counter and fabric-call trace span to reach Muninn under WORKER process kind via agent relay.
gherkinSteps: Given a real deployed module making a real fabric call, When its worker relays MetricsSnapshot/TracesSnapshot to its agent, Then the agent forwards it to Muninn and it's readable via GET /metrics-history/*.

requirements.feature: Artifact registry (Andvari) resolution path end to end
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a jar pushed to Andvari and a coordinate-only deployment to resolve through a real agent pull-through cache and reach ACTIVE.
gherkinSteps: Given a real Andvari replica and a pushed jar, When a coordinate-only deployment is submitted, Then the agent resolves and caches the jar and the instance reaches ACTIVE.

requirements.feature: External HTTP request reaches a fabric service through the gateway
requirements.userStory: As an external client, I want an HTTP request to gimle-gateway (deployed as a DaemonSet in gimle-system) to route to a real fabric service and return its response.
gherkinSteps: Given greeter-provider and gimle-gateway deployed as a DaemonSet on an edge-labeled node, When an external client hits the gateway, Then the response reflects a real fabric call to greeter-provider.

requirements.feature: Declarative cluster topology DSL/YAML parsing and validation
requirements.userStory: As a validation-suite author, I want to declare a real cluster's shape as YAML or a fluent Java DSL.
gherkinSteps: Given a topologies/*.yaml file or a ClusterTopology.named(...) DSL chain, When parsed/built, Then a ClusterSpec results; the one unsupported combination (fault-proxied + mTLS) is rejected before any process spawns.

requirements.feature: Real subprocess cluster orchestration (`GimleCluster`)
requirements.userStory: As a scenario author, I want a single API to boot every process kind a topology declares as real subprocesses.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: Foundation for every scenario in this module
gherkinSteps: Given a ClusterSpec, When GimleCluster.start(spec, workDir) runs, Then every declared process is a live, correctly-wired real subprocess reachable through cluster.api()/cluster.when().

requirements.feature: Cluster pooling per topology with destructive-scenario isolation
requirements.userStory: As the Gherkin runner, I want non-destructive scenarios to share one pooled cluster per topology while @destructive scenarios get a fresh, exclusively-owned cluster.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: Exercised implicitly by every HolmgangIT-run Gherkin scenario
gherkinSteps: Given a scenario tagged @destructive, When it starts, Then a brand-new GimleCluster is booted solely for it; non-destructive scenarios reuse the shared pooled cluster.

requirements.feature: JUnit `@Holmgang`/`@HolmgangCluster` extension for plain-JUnit cluster tests
requirements.userStory: As a plain-JUnit test author, I want an annotation-driven extension that boots a named topology and injects the live cluster into my test.
gherkinSteps: Given a class annotated @Holmgang(topology="...") with a @HolmgangCluster field, When JUnit runs the test, Then the extension boots the topology and injects the cluster.

requirements.feature: Fenrir randomized chaos-fault soak executor
requirements.userStory: As a platform reliability engineer, I want a seeded, weighted-pool fault scheduler that strikes a healthy real cluster repeatedly and gates every next strike on full recovery.
requirements.testCoverageDetail: `FenrirPlanTest`, `ChaosScheduleTest`; end-to-end via `chaos-soak.feature`/`observability-registry-ha.feature` `ChaosPlanParserTest` (YAML config parsing added in the ragnarok CLI phase).
gherkinSteps: Given a FenrirPlan with a soak duration and strike interval, When Fenrir.unleash(cluster, plan) runs, Then it repeatedly draws a fault kind/victim, applies it, and awaits recovery through Heimdall, recording each strike into a ChaosLedger.

requirements.feature: Chaos ledger recording and rendering
requirements.userStory: As a chaos-soak scenario author, I want every strike's outcome recorded and renderable as a human-readable summary.
gherkinSteps: Given a completed Fenrir run, When its ChaosLedger is queried, Then executedCount()/recoveredCount()/skippedCount()/allRecovered() reflect actual strikes.

requirements.feature: Randomized fault soak with no lost writes (basic and compound-fault modes)
requirements.userStory: As a platform reliability engineer, I want the whole cluster to survive a randomized fault soak while a live write workload runs throughout, proving no acknowledged write is ever lost.
gherkinSteps: Given a running HA cluster and a background write workload, When Fenrir is unleashed striking every 15s, Then at least 3 faults execute, every fault recovers, and every acknowledged write remains readable.

requirements.feature: Muninn/Andvari replica-bounce resilience soak
requirements.userStory: As a platform reliability engineer, I want targeted chaos coverage of Muninn's fan-out and Andvari's peer-sync, bouncing only their replicas.
gherkinSteps: Given a topology with 2 Muninn and 2 Andvari replicas, When Fenrir strikes only Muninn/Andvari bounces, Then at least 2 faults execute and recover, and a coordinate-only deployment still reaches ACTIVE afterward.

requirements.feature: Live store membership change (AddServer/RemoveServer)
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want to add a new store node to a running Raft cluster and later remove one, with writes accepted throughout.
gherkinSteps: Given a 3-store HA cluster, When a fourth store node joins, Then the store reports 4 members and accepts writes; leaving reports 3 members again.

requirements.feature: Mutual TLS end-to-end operation and anonymous-client rejection
requirements.userStory: As a security-conscious operator, I want the whole cluster to run with mTLS on every inter-process hop, and any anonymous client turned away.
gherkinSteps: Given an mTLS-transport cluster, When greeter-provider is deployed with a tenant secret, Then it logs the secret value within 60s; an anonymous client attempting a write is rejected with 401.

requirements.feature: Control-plane partition tolerance (store-side) and reconvergence on heal
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a control-plane replica cut off from the store cluster to stop serving, while the surviving replica keeps handling all work.
gherkinSteps: Given a fault-proxied HA cluster, When the network between control plane 1 and all stores is cut, Then control plane 1 stops serving within 30s while a submission via replica 0 still reaches ACTIVE; on heal, also ACTIVE via replica 1.

requirements.feature: Store leader self-demotion under silent peer partition; bounded write latency
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a Raft leader silently cut off from its followers to step down within a bounded window, and any in-flight write to complete rather than hang.
gherkinSteps: Given an HA cluster, When the store leader is partitioned, Then it steps down within 10s; a write submitted during the partition completes within 30s (success or failure).

requirements.feature: Tenant deployment lifecycle with secret delivery and clean deletion
requirements.userStory: As a tenant operator, I want a tenant-scoped module to deploy, read its secret through Fafnir, and be completely drained on deletion.
gherkinSteps: Given a tenant secret and a deployment submitted, When the instance starts, Then it logs the secret within 60s; on deletion, absent within 60s.

requirements.feature: Tenant quota retroactive violation (flag, not evict) and admission rejection
requirements.userStory: As a tenant operator, I want a retroactively-lowered quota to flag a violation without eviction, and an over-quota submission rejected.
gherkinSteps: Given a tenant at quota, When quota is lowered, Then the deployment reports a violation within 60s while keeping its 1 ACTIVE instance for 10s; a starved-tenant submission is rejected with 409.

requirements.feature: Node cordoning blocks placement until uncordoned
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a cordoned node to leave a submitted deployment unplaced, and let the placement proceed once uncordoned.
gherkinSteps: Given node-1 cordoned, When a deployment is submitted, Then it stays unplaced for 10s; uncordoning it, the deployment reaches ACTIVE within 120s.

requirements.feature: Worker-tier self-healing and liveness-exhaustion escalation (Gherkin coverage)
requirements.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a killed worker JVM respawned with the deployment returning to ACTIVE, and a module that never passes liveness to escalate to FAILED.
